evidence.text: Stage 2 implementation now treats an edge marked retry as requiring attempts, while retaining Stage 1 behavior that validates attempts whenever callers provide it. Retry validation requires type(attempts) is int (excluding bool), an integer retry_limit, and 0 <= attempts < retry_limit. Role denial precedes retry validation; missing edges remain blocked. Actual checks passed 11 boundary cases, input immutability, exact output fields, report consistency, schema validation, and compilation.
